age.evidence: All experiments were started on postnatal day (PND) 40... The time from postnatal day 40-50 is recognized as mid to late adolescence in mice

sex.evidence: Twenty-eight C57BL/J6 mice, half male/half female

dosing.evidence: Each mouse received a 100 µl gavage... for an approximate dose of 3.0 mg/kg of PSI... The vehicle group received a comparable volume 0.9% saline. Mice were gavaged every other day for 10 days for a total of five treatments.

group_housing.evidence: Animals were housed in plastic cages (3-5 per cage)

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained ... on a 12:12 reverse light:dark cycle (lights off at 09:00 h)

assays.assay_description: 1764 cm² Plexiglas arena divided into 16 zones (4 center, 12 periphery); 4-min free exploration under dim red light; ANYMaze software analyzed video for center time, center entries, total distance, average speed, center crossings.

application_type.evidence: Each mouse received a 100 µl gavage... for an approximate dose of 3.0 mg/kg of PSI.

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals explored a 1764 cm² Plexiglas arena... for 4 min

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum [in home cage]; no food in apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum [in home cage]; no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: Five weeks post-PSI administration, anxiety and locomotion were assessed using the Open Field test

sample_size.evidence: When the data between sexes were collapse (vehicle n = 14, PSI n = 14)

outcomes.summary: Adolescent psilocybin exposure reduced locomotor activity in females; vehicle-treated females showed greater total distance, speed and center crossings than PSI-treated females, yielding a significant sex × treatment interaction for center crossings. Males were not significantly affected.
outcomes.statistics: Center Crossing interaction: F = 10.780, p = 0.003; Total Distance: F = 3.579, p = 0.070; Average Speed: F = 3.063, p = 0.093; collapsed Total Distance p = 0.0287; Average Speed p = 0.042
outcomes.evidence: there was a significant interaction between sex by treatment for Center Crossing (F=10.780, p=0.003)... PSI treatment significantly decreased female behavior as compared to vehicle treated females.

B1_num_measures.evidence: center time, center entries, locomotion... Total Distance traveled, Average Speed, Center Crossings

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Measures reported as totals over the 4-min session.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences described.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only locomotor and spatial measures recorded.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: ANYMaze software analyzed video recordings (position tracking).

D5_followup.evidence: Five weeks post-PSI administration... assessed using the Open Field test.

assays.assay_description: Two adjoining compartments (27×27×27 cm each); bright open area at 1000 lux and dark enclosed chamber <1 lux connected by 7×7 cm opening; 10-min session videotaped and scored for latency to first enter light, total transitions, and cumulative time in each compartment.

application_type.evidence: Each mouse received a 100 µl gavage... for an approximate dose of 3.0 mg/kg of PSI.

setup_restrain.evidence: allowed the mice to move freely between the two sections

food_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum [in home cage]; no food in apparatus.

water_restriction.evidence: Food and water were provided ad libitum [in home cage]; no water in apparatus.

time_to_assay.evidence: Four weeks post treatment mice were evaluated in the Light/Dark Box

sample_size.evidence: When the data between sexes were collapsed (vehicle n = 13, PSI n = 14)

outcomes.summary: No significant effect of adolescent psilocybin exposure on Light/Dark Box measures (latency, transitions, time in compartments) in either sex.
outcomes.statistics: time in light: F=2.089, p=0.162; time in dark: F=2.072, p=0.164; light box entries p=0.6020; dark box entries p=0.567
outcomes.evidence: A two-way ANOVA showed no significant differences for each dependent measure in the Light/Dark box (p > 0.05).

B1_num_measures.evidence: scored for the latency to first enter the light compartment, total number of transitions between compartments and cumulative time spent in each compartment.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: Transitions counted as a total, not analyzed as sequences.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate anxiety test, no learning component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: videotaped and scored, no advanced classifier described.

E1_environment_type.evidence: two adjoining compartments... standard light-dark box

E2_shelter.evidence: a dark, enclosed chamber of the same dimensions, illuminated at <1 lux

E6_spatial.evidence: two adjoining compartments... connected by a small opening (7 × 7 cm)

D5_followup.evidence: Four weeks post treatment mice were evaluated in the Light/Dark Box

assays.assay_description: Awake fMRI BOLD scanning of mice (after 5-day acclimation to imaging procedure) during nose-cone delivery of a rewarding odor (benzaldehyde/almond) and, two weeks later, an aversive predator odor (TMT/fox). Each session = 150 scan repetitions over 15 min; 5-min baseline followed by continuous odor stimulus. Primary outcome was odor-evoked BOLD signal change across 139 atlas-defined brain areas; the behavioural readout is the animal's neural/sensory response to natural rewarding vs. aversive olfactory stimuli during head-restrained awake imaging.

application_type.evidence: Each mouse received a 100 µl gavage... for an approximate dose of 3.0 mg/kg of PSI.

setup_habituation.evidence: These functional imaging studies were done in fully awake mice following five days of acclimation to the awake imaging procedure.

setup_restrain.evidence: awake imaging procedure... odor stimulant was introduced through nose cone attached to a pump (awake head-fixed MRI)

time_to_assay.evidence: on PND 176, ca 20 weeks post exposure, odor-induced changes in BOLD activity were conducted

sample_size.evidence: female vehicle n = 4, male vehicle n = 6, female PSI n = 6, and male PSI n = 6

outcomes.summary: PSI-exposed mice showed reduced positive BOLD responses to the rewarding almond odor (50/139 regions lower than vehicle) and enhanced negative BOLD responses to the aversive fox odor (TMT) (27/139 regions), indicating dampened brain sensitivity to both rewarding and aversive olfactory stimuli after adolescent psilocybin exposure.
outcomes.statistics: voxel-wise one-sample t-tests, two-tailed, p < 0.05 with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR Q = 0.05; 50/139 regions positive BOLD higher in vehicle vs PSI (almond); 27/139 regions negative BOLD higher in PSI vs vehicle (TMT)
outcomes.evidence: 50/139 brain areas showing higher positive BOLD signal in veh over PSI... PSI mice showed a significantly higher negative BOLD as compared to vehicle in 27/139 brain areas

B1_num_measures.evidence: Positive BOLD response to almond and negative BOLD response to TMT measured.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Voxel comparisons were made between baseline (1-50 image acquisitions) and the initial odor presentation (51-100 image acquisitions)

B4_ethological.evidence: Outcome is neural BOLD response, not natural behavioural acts.

B6_cognitive.evidence: No learning component; innate olfactory responses.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Voxel-wise statistical mapping, not behavioural classification.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Voxel-wise univariate t-tests with FDR correction.

E1_environment_type.evidence: MRI scanner with awake-imaging head holder.

E7_social_context.evidence: Single animal scanned at a time.

D1_continuity.evidence: almond session, then TMT session two weeks later

D2_session_duration.evidence: uninterrupted data acquisitions... 150 scan repetitions or acquisitions for a total elapsed time of 15 min

D3_recording_days.evidence: Two weeks later mice were exposed to TMT (two recording days)

D4_baseline.evidence: No pre-drug BOLD recording prior to adolescent PSI exposure.

D5_followup.evidence: on PND 176, ca 20 weeks post exposure

judge_notes: Both Qwen and GLM and GPT-OSS scored only the two overt behavioural assays (OFT and Light/Dark Box). The odor-induced awake BOLD imaging combines an active sensory-behavioural stimulation with restraint; per rubric, fMRI with a behavioural/sensory task is scorable as the behavioural component. Added as a third assay.
rsFC (resting state) and VBM/DWI structural scans are pure neural/anatomical imaging without a behavioural task and were correctly omitted by all candidates.
Strain harmonized to C57BL/6J (paper text 'C57BL/J6' is the same strain with a typographic variant).
time_to_assay for OFT and L/D box: paper states 'Five weeks post-PSI administration' (OFT) and 'Four weeks post treatment' (L/D). Both fall in long_term_over7d; minutes are approximate.
B1 for OFT: candidates report 4 measures (center time, center entries, total distance, average speed, center crossings) → category 4-6 → score 2.
